steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Order.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: The witnesses have spoken. All present have heard their statements.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Considering the scope of the Katorga Incident, and the many contradictions in the testimonies we have heard...

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: The committee will now adjourn to deliberate behind closed doors.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: This hearing is hereby concluded. We will announce the final verdict on the Katorga Incident in two hours.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (Whispers) It's time.
Discussions surround her again. A few nobles accompany the arbiter out of the chamber and into the inner council building.
Absinthe shakes her head and walks through the noisy crowd, meeting the parliamentarian's eyes as she leaves.
The parliamentarian is impassive, his gaze penetrating her and casting into nothingness beyond. But he silently raises his notebook—
It is completely empty.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Phew... what a farce.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Even the scion of Treplev strays. It is beyond belief.

steps.name: Anxious Noble
steps.text: The focus is still on Sonya Mykhailivna. How do you intend to portray her, Arbiter?

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: It depends on what kind of 'cautionary tale' we need her to be.

steps.name: Anxious Noble
steps.text: We need her to be a lunatic.

steps.name: Anxious Noble
steps.text: The new nobles are trying to use His Imperial Majesty as a shield. They even have the audacity to praise her for protecting the emperor!

steps.name: Anxious Noble
steps.text: We must magnify Sonya Mykhailivna's threat. This is our opportunity to deal with the upstarts now. Fail to do so, and they will grow even bolder and continue to distort the truth!

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: We will decide when Duke Treplev arrives. He needs time to recover from the shock.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Arbiter!

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Word just came in that Prison No. 3 was raided! Many prisoners have escaped.

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: It's a mess out there right now. Your presence is needed to maintain order.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: How did they get into Prison No. 3 so easily?!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Most of our units were deployed to this area. Those left were unable to spot the miscreants in time.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: The students outside?

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: They just dispersed. Do you mean...?

steps.name: Arbiter
steps.text: I mean find their leader and bring him in right this instant, you fool!

steps.name: Ursine Police
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Hey, wake up!

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: You must be Rania. We've seized this prison.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: We should leave before reinforcements arrive.

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: Is this real... you came to rescue me?

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Not just you. Come.
Feeling a mixture of joy and surprise through his sleepy mind, Rania steps over a jailer lying on the ground.
His thoughts drift. So his reputation has grown so great... he will return to the Student Assembly, and become a leader on par with Olga.

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: Students... friends, comrades!

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: I knew that the flames of liberty never died as soon as I saw you!

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Group Two, hold the gap! The cells on this side are all open!

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: *cough*—

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: As you can see, though the dank cage trapped my flesh, it could never hold my—

steps.name: Busy Student
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: ...It's alright.

steps.name: Rania
steps.text: I know you came for me. For—
No one answers. His former fellows seem so unfamiliar to him now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Phew, I'm exhausted.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'd hardly gotten the dust of that hellhole off before you dragged me into this.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, quit complaining, not even Zoya's saying anything.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Are your plans always this bold, Sonya?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I didn't think we could pull this off right under their noses...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We were worried when you said you would appear at the hearing to stall for time.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya had already made the arrangements. You didn't need to take the risk.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Gummy didn't have to be here, but she came.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph, speaking of which...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I already apologized! Besides, I hardly got hurt at all, and Istina said I helped! Don't scold me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who said I was scolding you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If not for you and Instructor Dur-nar... and Crownslayer, we would have had to be on guard against attacks from the mobility layer. You definitely helped.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hey, she admits it. Just as today's operation may not have gone so smoothly if Zoya hadn't gone to the hearing and played her role.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: We won't exclude anyone anymore.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I wasn't excluding them... never mind. We all saw that my plan was bad.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But I didn't expect to see all the students with all their different ideas and methods come together into a single coherent team by the time I saw you all again.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Good work, Istina.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Who was the reckless fool who gave me no choice but to do that?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Alright, both of you, it's time for us to think about what's next.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh yeah, before we left, Instructor Dur-nar told us not to go back to the office when we're done, and go straight to a safehouse that Rhodes Island prepared.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: How did she put it... 'lay low until it blows over'?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We'll have to operate covertly in Grypherburg moving forward. Fortunately, I've already made arrangements with the school, and we'll have no problem receiving intel from them.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Let's get moving, then.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Aren't you forgetting something, Zoya?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What?
Seeing Zima's inquiring gaze, she realizes what Zima was talking about and takes out a brand-new iron badge from her bag. A tightly clenched fist is depicted upon the badge.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Good, you have it. Don't you forget it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You should have been one of us. You are now, and you always will be.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Zima...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: My condolences, Zoya.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Zima may be all smiles and sunshine most of the time, and she never used to like wearing this herself. But now, wait till you see the look on her face if she ever catches you without that badge—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's enough of that. We have some laying low to get to.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So many twists and turns. This place sure is hard to find.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Probably to ensure security.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Yeah. Zoya and I were moving from safehouse to safehouse, just like this, from one week to the next while you were operating in the other cities, so that we could continue to receive intel and plan our next steps.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Not a job for me, at any rate. I would be bored to death in two days under normal circumstances.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It's not that bad.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Just Rosalind being her restless self.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There you are.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh, this is your safehouse?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Just consider it as Rhodes Island's.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya, is that...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: 'Crownslayer' Lyudmila. Operator for the Grypherburg office, just like us.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: They don't recognize you. Looks like you didn't really take what I said to heart.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Rhodes resources in Ursus are limited. They should be reserved for those who need them the most.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Besides, I did go to the office and got Gummy's help.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: We helped each other!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well, that's a start, at least.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You can stay here for a while. Dur-nar will let you know once things blow over.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hm? What about you?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm leaving Grypherburg for a bit.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There has been a major development with the mark I was tracking. I have to go and verify.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Gummy...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why are you following me? Go back.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're going to the place Papa talked about in the message, aren't you?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: It's my mission.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's my Papa.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I don't even know which satellite city he was talking about specifically. Following me doesn't mean you'll find your father.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: It's not about the danger. But it's just not necessary right now for you to—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Lyudmila.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Will you tell me if you find that satellite city and see my parents?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Okay. I have one more question.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Rosa said you used to be with Reunion.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But Zima said it wasn't important, and Leto said she didn't plan on having much to do with you anyway.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina and Absinthe were quiet. I have my own ideas.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You weren't there, were you?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You weren't at Peterheim.
The red-haired woman falls silent. She clutches her fists in the darkness before relaxing them.
She looks into the girl's earnest eyes, then slowly shakes her head.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: But I was in Chernobog.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I was part of Reunion. I share responsibility for its evils, whether they passed through my hands or not.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Running away won't do any good. I don't ask for forgiveness or reconciliation. But this time, just this once...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If there's still a chance to make things right again, I have to go and take it.
Gummy's eyes widen as she ponders Crownslayer's words. Then she smiles and takes out a honey drop from her pocket.
Through the gloves, she puts it into Crownslayer's palm.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What's this—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: A promise.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I know why Zima said it wasn't important. We've grown up, we're old enough that we can find calm in our hearts without having to take it out on someone, without having to hate.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll wait for you to come back, with news about Papa or Mama—or both!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I want to believe. I want to believe in you, Lyudmila.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: The following day, I went back to that street, alone.

steps.name: Cautious Worker
steps.text: Hey, careful, this job's from the Council faction, if we break anything—

steps.name: Excited Worker
steps.text: Did you see it, though? That idiot Pavlovich was crushed to a pulp in that quarantine zone.

steps.name: Excited Worker
steps.text: Maybe we all trampled his corpse!

steps.name: Cautious Worker
steps.text: Keep quiet! Not everyone here's on our side.

steps.name: Excited Worker
steps.text: Come on, who else could there be, we're all—

steps.name: Excited Worker
steps.text: W-Who are you?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I'm looking for someone. I won't bother you. If you're worried that I might snitch—

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Pavlovich deserved it.
Antosha bows and walks through the workers to the other side of the street, that door in his memories.
After he was expelled and left penniless, it was Matvey who took him home, where he really felt like he was eating with family for the first time since he came to Grypherburg.
He remembers Matvey's mother, always with a serene smile on her face as she stirred the pot of borscht and quietly ladled one of the few pieces of meat into his bowl.
He looks up, greeted by the familiar scent of beets and onions.
Dim light seeps out of the slightly open curtain. He could not help but peek.
An old woman takes out a clay pot from the cramped kitchen, and pours borscht into three separate bowls.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Three?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Could that be for me—

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: What did you write in your letter...?
Hello? Somebody there?
Hearing a voice coming from inside the house, he tucks the notice of Matvey's death into the edge of the window and flees like a thief in the night.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: (Whispers) Govno!

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: (Whispers) When did you become such a coward, Antosha?

steps.name: Resting Worker
steps.text: What's the rush, young man? Could you move over a little?

steps.name: Resting Worker
steps.text: The burdenbeast's tired. Moving old furniture's not an easy task, eh?
Antosha nods and shifts sideways.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Matvey?!
The mirror on the burdenbeast cart reflects the grey street, his own unkempt visage, and a silhouette from what is now the past.
Matvey's face is covered in sunlight. He seems so real, so alive, no lamentation on his face, nor dust-covered wound, only a cherry flower on his chest...
The color of blood, diffuses from the center of the flower out towards the petals.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Is that you, friend?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I saw you, List, Yura... I...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: I remember everyone's death, your prayers and farewells, and those who never left their last words.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Will you tell me that none of this was real? You will, won't you?

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: No, Antosha.

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: Did you ever imagine the life I could have led?

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: I would have stayed in school, made more friends, and writtn the first poem of the year by the river in the spring.

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: When there is no class in the afternoon, I would have gone home, reading the words I wrote for my mother while she made soup.

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: She would not understand, but she would smile and say, 'Tuck in, my university synochek.'

spans.text: She would not understand, but she would smile and say, 'Tuck in, my university

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Matvey, Matvey...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Why am I the one who lived...

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: Because you still have a chance to live the life I wanted.

steps.name: 'Matvey'
steps.text: Let it go, Antosha. You have carried that burden for so many years.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: A beautiful life like that... can I truly live it?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: ...Can every Ursine?

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: If I had never chosen to resist this land of oppression, Matvey...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Would you and I have become friends?
The figure from the past does not answer, but only sighs softly.
It is the second time that Antosha has wept since he left home.
He still lives, but part of his soul will remain beneath the rubble of Katorga forever.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Live...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: If I give up now, Matvey will forever remain a traitor to the empire's nobility.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: One day, I will carve his name and the professor's, and the names of all the Unbound, on a plaque for the martyrs...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Give me time, my friend.
He wipes his eyes with his dirty, dusty sleeves.
Then, he moves his feet and joins the workers' procession.
On the other end of the procession, a young man gazes upon this unfamiliar city, not even realizing that the crate on his shoulder has slipped off.

steps.name: Friendly Worker
steps.text: Hey, brother!

steps.name: Friendly Worker
steps.text: What's so interesting? Let us see it too.

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: I think... no, never mind.

steps.name: Friendly Worker
steps.text: You've been with us for a few days already, no need to be shy! Look more cheerful, we're in Grypherburg!

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Grypherburg...

steps.name: Nikto
steps.text: Yes, it was a hard journey to Grypherburg...
The light in the sky begins to fade, like a curtain being closed.

steps.name: Nervous Officer
steps.text: What's the Marshal summoning us for?

steps.name: Nervous Officer
steps.text: Is it not enough that he beheaded his bodyguards for the assassination attempt? Does he want our heads too?

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: Or you're overthinking it. There's just some situation developing.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: Even after that small rebellion two weeks ago, the Fourth Army is still in a stalemate with the Second Army on the whole.

steps.name: Nervous Officer
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: It's just a guess, but we may not be able to stay out of this for much longer.

steps.name: Nervous Officer
steps.text: But the First Army has always been—

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: Always been?

steps.name: Nervous Officer
steps.text: ...A-Always been independent of any faction. We do not participate in political struggles, and we only ever fight for Ursus's interests.

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: And in that case, you have nothing to fear.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: If I may be frank, Marshal, you must have an important reason for summoning us back from our respective assignments.

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Stern Officer
steps.text: What is the reason?

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: Our new weapon has passed theoretical validation. It is now ready for testing.

steps.name: Dignified Soldier
steps.text: We must coordinate and conclude this test discreetly.

spans.text: We must coordinate and conclude this test
